summary.content:
Today's selection covers 69 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 49 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI makes ChatGPT less 'human' for teens in new safety update
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CISA: Windows Task Host flaw now exploited by ransomware gangs
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
